biography: Steve 'The Comet' Hill, a name synonymous with raw aggression and undeniable flash, hails from the unassuming town of Market Deeping, Lincolnshire. Unlike many racers groomed from karting age, Hill's journey began in the muddy fields of his family's farm, tearing around in a battered Land Rover. It was this unorthodox training that forged his fearless, almost reckless style. His big break came at 25, winning a local rallycross event in a borrowed Mitsubishi Lancer. The victory, achieved by the skin of his teeth and sheer audacity, caught the attention of a small, independent team. Hill rapidly ascended the rallycross ranks, known for his spectacular crashes and even more spectacular comebacks. Now, at 38, he's a veteran, still chasing that elusive championship win, proving that raw talent and unwavering self-belief can take you further than pedigree ever could. He is known to still visit the farm and offer rides to locals.
drivingStyle: Hill's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He attacks every corner with unwavering commitment, often pushing the limits of adhesion to the extreme. Tire management is not his forte; he prefers to extract every last ounce of performance from the rubber, even if it means a dramatic drop-off in the later stages of a race. Under pressure, Hill either thrives, unleashing a burst of speed and aggression, or implodes spectacularly, making costly errors. There is no in-between. He is known to over-rev the engine.

rivalries.name: Marco 'Iceman' Rossi
rivalries.reason: A clash of styles - Rossi's clinical precision versus Hill's wild abandon. Their contrasting personalities often led to heated exchanges both on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Anika 'Storm' Schmidt
rivalries.reason: A rivalry born from numerous close finishes and on-track collisions. Schmidt accused Hill of overly aggressive tactics, fueling a fiery competition.

rivalries.name: Kenji 'Ronin' Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A respectful but intense rivalry. Tanaka, a master of car control, often outmaneuvered Hill with finesse, much to Hill's frustration.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of argyle socks, no matter the temperature.
Listens to a specific 80s power ballad playlist before every race.
Has to have a cup of builder's tea, extra strong, exactly one hour before the start.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 Rallycross of Titans after starting from the back of the grid due to a mechanical failure in qualifying, overtaking seven cars in the final lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2021 Championship finale while leading, handing the title to his arch-rival, Marco Rossi.
